records.title: On-device inference baseline and tool-call measurements
records.result: Basic inference and tool-call behavior were measurable. Repeated tool-call tests selected the intended directory tool and produced the intended argument in 3/3 runs for the tested case.

measurements.note: Historical short-turn measurement; not the later full T39 inference battery.

records.notes: Historical record retained for provenance. Exact handset identity, package paths, build hashes and raw logs remain private.

records.title: Round 73 full local-inference battery on a physical low-memory device
records.result: 33 core.inference cases completed green in the physical-device battery. The LocalInferenceDeviceTest execution provided the current full-run inference measurement.
records.notes: This record supersedes neither nor deletes the earlier short-turn measurement; it is a later, larger protocol. The 31.7 tok/s prefill value is tied to this physical-device run and should not be compared with generation throughput or with the older short-turn protocol without matching workload conditions.

records.title: Controlled llama.cpp v0.4.1 × v0.5.0 paired battery
records.protocol: T137 paired battery, five repetitions, alternating order, one warm-up discarded per install
records.result: NEUTRAL on fixed-work rows. v0.5.0 showed no measured speed gain or regression against v0.4.1 within the paired battery's noise band.
records.notes: Same physical device, same GGUF and instrumentation. Generation elapsed time was not compared because the two arms emitted different token counts. The separate Vulkan experiment measured the GPU offload path as 7.2× slower on prefill and +35.26 MB native library size; it remains build-time only.

records.title: Round 73 instrumented suite on CI AVD
records.protocol: First CI instrumented suite run after account-block recovery
records.result: The CI instrumented job was red: 330 tests, 3 failures and 27 skipped in approximately 3 minutes. The same three classes were green on the physical phone in the same development window, so this is an environment-sensitive result and is not treated as a product-wide failure.

measurements.physical_cross_check: same three classes green on physical device

records.notes: AVD was headless with animations disabled by the CI step and used a fresh installation. The repository explicitly leaves triage open; the red is not explained away as code or environment without further reproduction.

records.title: alpha.96 CI-built release artifact verification
records.protocol: CI release artifact build, download and post-build identity verification
records.result: CI completed preflight, prune-artifacts, build, release and publish-packages successfully. Both published APKs were downloaded and re-measured; local and CI APKs differed by 16 bytes, attributed in the repository record to toolchain differences.
records.notes: The public dataset records artifact identity and CI provenance without exposing private operational paths.

records.title: Core inference device test suite
records.result: 18/18 tests passed in the complete device run. Model import, load-failure diagnostics, model-specific checks and inference-path checks completed successfully; one earlier run was interrupted by process control conditions and was repeated to completion.
records.notes: Retained as the earlier 18-test subset record; the later round-73 T39 record reports the expanded 33-case core.inference group.

records.title: PDF extraction device regression validation
records.result: The PDF extraction device regression suite passed 6/6 tests in 5.3 seconds, including the upgrade-path case that restores the bundled Python wheel and imports it after an app update.
records.notes: The paired fixes addressed stale site-packages detection and loss of the no-text-layer page sentence during AttachmentContent round trips.

records.title: Adversarial playtest findings converted into engineering corrections
records.result: A set of high-impact workflow failures was reproduced and corrected, including runtime-status presentation, image handling, cross-model task continuity, sanctioned HTML preview, execution-state cleanup, transcript persistence, and reopening the last conversation.

records.title: Runtime and workflow resilience review
records.result: The reviewed workflow includes explicit execution state, recovery paths, persisted activity, project preview through a sanctioned local server, workspace transfer, Git operations inside the workspace, structured test execution results, and persisted image attachments for retry.

measurements.review_scope: runtime, persistence, preview, workspace, git, test execution

records.notes: Capability-history record, not a performance benchmark.

records.title: Live local-model end-to-end loop
records.result: 3/3 runs completed successfully. The real chat flow reached the on-device model, executed the expected list_directory tool call, reused KV-cache context on the next turn, and completed with a prose response.
records.notes: The measurement covers the production onboarding path, real chat route, real Send action, live local inference and durable transcript result. It is an end-to-end workflow measurement, not a throughput benchmark.

records.title: External process-death recovery for composer drafts
records.protocol: External process-death matrix using Android activity-manager kill
records.result: The complete matrix of 10 external process-death cases passed. An unsent composer draft returned after process recreation with its text and attachment order; an image whose local copy disappeared returned explicitly marked as unavailable and the composer communicated that state.
records.notes: The public record intentionally omits handset identity, package paths, process identifiers and raw logs. This validates recovery behavior across an externally terminated process, rather than an in-app navigation or rotation case.

records.title: Instrumented validation window after the alpha.2 changes
records.protocol: 95 instrumented classes executed in four resumable class-filtered chunks
records.result: The completed validation chunks contain 342 passed cases and 19 skipped cases, with no completed-case failures. One targeted local-inference sampling case remains an explicitly measured open red and is tracked separately rather than being hidden by the aggregate.
records.notes: Skipped cases are declared test preconditions or opt-in paths, not failures. The aggregate must not be read as evidence that the open sampling case is green.

records.title: Local tool-shortlist sampling: open model-selection red
records.result: OPEN RED: the model emitted no tool call in 0/3 executions. Code inspection and JVM guards show the expected shortlist was offered, so this measurement currently points to model sampling behavior rather than a proven tool-catalog plumbing defect.
records.notes: This is intentionally published as an open red. The earlier assertion wording suggested a wrong-family choice, but the device trace showed an absent call; the distinction matters for the next investigation.
